cases.intent: Enter the verification code into the verification code field
Click Use template on the Simple email template
Click Advanced filters to filter the contacts
Type the first name into the First name field
Click the Notes tab on the contact record
Select Contacts as the type of data to import
Click Next to continue past the column mapping step
Click Edit filters to modify the advanced filter
Click Next to proceed with the import column mapping
Click Create company to add a new company
Click + Add to associate a company with the contact
Click the Sequences tab in the email composer
Click the Quick Chat with Mia meeting activity
Click Next: Define deal stages to continue
Type the deal amount into the Amount field
Click the Apex Media Group Sponsorship deal card
Click the Make super admin checkbox
